facts.claim: 18세기부터 해양 모피 무역으로 약 100만 마리가 사냥되었다
facts.note: Large-scale hunting, part of the Maritime Fur Trade, which would eventually kill approximately one million sea otters (beginning in the 18th century)
the world population fell to 1,000–2,000 individuals living in a fraction of their historic range

facts.claim: 1제곱센티미터에 15만 가닥, 동물 가운데 가장 빽빽한 털
facts.note: With up to 150,000 strands of hair per square centimetre (970,000/in2), its fur is the densest of any animal.

facts.claim: 다른 바다 포유류와 달리 지방층이 없고 두꺼운 털로 체온 유지
facts.note: Unlike most other marine mammals, the sea otter has no blubber and relies on its exceptionally thick fur to keep warm.

facts.claim: 앞다리 밑 피부 주머니에 먹이와 돌을 넣고 다님
facts.note: Under each foreleg, the sea otter has a loose pouch of skin that extends across the chest. In this pouch (preferentially the left one), the animal stores collected food to bring to the surface, and sometimes a rock that is used to break open shellfish and clams.
